about: The brawler as data (docs/brawler_data_model.md): roster (layer 1), enemies + AI presets (layer 2), stages (layer 3). tools/brawler/build_tables.py turns it into the tables the game reads (build/game_tables.c / .h, build/roster.json for the fighter export).

roster_benched.about: Fighters out of the roster for now (not exported, not on the select screen); their data, exporters and scenarios stay. Moving an entry back into roster (and select_layout) brings it back. Kuroko: TODO #212 (Bruno 2026-10-07: 'Remove Kuroko for now'); his select_layout entry was {x 249, y 183, z 20, facing left, pose [0, 0], slot 7}, now Cheng-Fu's place.

meter.about: the two bars (Bruno's live redesign 2026-10-08, docs/brawler_gold.md; fighter.c 'the meter'), players only (enemies pay nothing). DRIVE (shown: the HUD's two chunks): chunks x chunk points, full at the start and at a new life, one point back a frame (a chunk refills in chunk frames: 240 = 4 s); a C special costs `special` chunks (short of them it does not come out), a breaker (C or A+B in a hit stun or held: always the fighter's neutral C special) costs `breaker` chunks and blinks WHITE (blink frames white, as many not) for the whole move; short of them it costs life_breaker life (never the last point) and blinks RED instead. FURY GAUGE (hidden, never drawn): fury_max points, filled fury_dealt a point of damage dealt and fury_taken a point taken (the fury's own hits not counted), empty at the start, kept at a new life, emptied by the fury; full: D = the fury, full and life <= low % of the full life: D = the MAX; while full the fighter blinks 1 frame its colours / 1 frame a shiny white palette (red 1 / 1 when the MAX is ready); the life bar blinks red at low life (KOF95's 8 / 8, main.c). infinite 1: nothing spent, both full (a test switch)

blitz.about: the Blitz (Bruno 2026-10-08, docs/brawler_gold.md): a free, meterless move on a double direction + A: forward,forward / down,down / down,up / up,up + A (roster[].blitz ff / dd / du / uu: a special of its pool played free, not invincible, its own recovery; 'dash' = its dash attack, its tree's dash entry; absent = nothing; every fighter without a blitz entry: ff = 'dash'). window: frames allowed between the two taps and from the second tap to A (main.c read_player); run + A plays the ff slot too. chord: A+B = C, pressed on the same frame, or the second within `chord` frames of the first (fighter.c turns a prejump / a normal's first frames into the C). damage: a special played as a Blitz deals this whole damage on a full connect (its special tier scaled by damage / tiers.special)

jump.about: ONE jump for every fighter (Bruno 2026-10-08): Cody's Final Fight arc, captured frame by frame from the ROM in /data/emu (FBNeo, World 900112: /data/tmp/newsys/scripts/ff_jump.py): crouch frames on the ground, then one height (lines above the floor) a frame in the air, dx the forward jump's travel a frame in CPS1 pixels (scaled by x_scale 320 / 384 to the Neo Geo's pixels: the same distance on a TV), land_dx on the landing frame; a straight jump has no travel, a back jump the forward's mirrored. land: the landing's frames, any input ends it from land_cancel on (FF: cancellable at once). Air attacks: forward jump + A (roster[].air.forward), straight jump + A (air.straight) knock down and stay active active_min frames at least; down + A in either jump (air.down) flinches and stays active to the landing; down + A cancels into the jump's attack on hit (down_cancel 'hit'; 'any': at any time). Defaults (a fighter without roster[].air): forward atk_d_jump, straight atk_c_jump, down atk_a_jump

walk.about: walk speeds by archetype (Bruno 2026-10-08: Terry = Cody, Kim = Guy, Krauser = Haggar): Final Fight's 2.10 / 1.95 / 1.85 CPS1 px a frame x 320 / 384 = the same time to cross the screen; sub-pixel (16.16, no whole-pixel rounding); run = run x walk; the walk / run animations play at the new speed / the fighter's KOF speed (feet don't slide); anim = the walk / run animations' frame rate x this on top (Bruno 2026-10-08: 1.5, the frames switch faster, the movement speed unchanged)

tiers.about: the damage tiers (revamp phase 2, Bruno 2026-10-08: specials about equal across all characters +-15 %, furies +-20 %, MAX +-20 %, special < fury < MAX; fighter.c 'damage tiers'): the whole damage of every special / fury / MAX on a full connect (life 60; the chain totals 21 / 23 / 27: a special about half a chain, a fury one heavy chain and more, the MAX two chains); spread = the allowed band in %, the bands may not overlap; measured = each move's own total in our emulator (tools/brawler/damage_tiers.py --raw --save), each move scaled to its tier; super_throw = the super throw's whole damage (revamp 3: between the special and the fury, a stock buys it)

chain.about: the chain core (revamp 1A, docs/brawler_feel.md 8h, fighter.c 'chain core', routes.py chain_tree): one system for every fighter. A chain advances only on a hit; a whiff or being hit restarts it at link 1. window: frames after a link's recovery to press the next one; buffer: a player's press this many frames (hit-stop not counted) before the next link may start still fires, a press in the hit-stop is latched; lengths: links by roster[].archetype (Final Fight's Guy 5 / Cody 4 / Haggar 3); totals: the whole chain's damage by archetype (Final Fight 42 / 46 / 54, halved to the brawler's life of 60); hitstop: [jab, finisher] frames, link k on that scale, every finisher the last (a special's / fury's / throw's: the engine's 7); juggle_cap: air hits a juggled fighter takes, then untouchable until it lands (downed: untouchable; a fury's own hits excepted); stun_player + guard_player: a player's hit stun and its untouchable window from the hit (only the one that hit it reaches it meanwhile); stun_light / stun_heavy: an enemy's hit stun. roster[].finishers: launcher = the stick that plays the launcher (up, forward or neutral), down = sweep (a trip) or slam (a ground slam that bounces), or null; neutral / forward / up / down_move = a move name to override the generator's pick

super_flash.about: fx.super_flash (TODO #139, Bruno 2026-10-06: an engine rule, no per-move data but an optional anchor): every fury (D) and MAX fury (down+D) of every fighter. From the fury's frame start the game freezes except the attacker for freeze frames (enemies, projectiles, the camera, waves and timers, other players; only the attacker's own boxes hit: Kim's Phoenix hits inside the flash, KOF's furies 39-47 frames in, after it), the stage is hidden and the backdrop is white_colour for white frames, then dark_colour; KOF98's concentration plays at the anchor (the move's own, read from its KOF animation, else this one: px from the feet, KOF orientation, negative x = forward), blue for a fury, orange for a MAX fury. Values: KOF98's (tools/kof96/handlers98.md 'Super flash': the flash effect's animation + 1 = 28 frames, its white event step + 1 = 4). sound (Bruno 2026-10-06, the fury charge): the effect played at the flash start, KOF98's own: the flash routine $370F0 / $373FC sends sound index $99 = $1A $3A for every DM and SDM alike (measured in our emulator: Terry, Ryo, Ralf, Kyo, DM and MAX, the same command on the flash frame); must be in songs.json sfx. sound_max (TODO #155, Bruno 2026-10-06: KOF2000's MAX sound, the high whistle): played instead of sound when the fury is the MAX (down+D): KOF2000's SDM flash effect, $1E $8F there (measured in our emulator: K' and Terry, every DM flash $1E $BC, every SDM flash $1E $8F), the brawler $1A $8F (songs.json sfx from)

rules.about: Every enemy's shared rules (revamp 1B, docs/brawler_data_model.md 'Enemy rules', ai.c): attack tokens, the ready pose during the random wait, wind-up by damage, the hidden difficulty rank.
